title.narrative: Preparation of Standard Bidding Documents & Standard Contract Forms IDF Grant

description.narrative: The aim of the IDF financing is to help the Government of Poland in preparation of Standard Documents comprising: Standard Pre-qualificationcomma Standard Bidding Documents and Standard Contract Forms to be used by public procuring entities and bidders. Description of Activities The Activities include (i) preparation of the Standard Pre-qualificationcomma Standard Bidding Documents and Standard Contract Forms (Standard Documents)comma the guidelines for their usecomma and the procurement procedures to be followed - under the auspices of the Public Procurement Office (PPO); (ii) dissemination of the Standard Documents to procuring entities throughout the countrycomma which would in turn disseminate them to the bidders participating in procurement proceedings; (iii) training in the use of the Standard Documents; and (iv) recommendations on amendments (if any) to the Act on Public Procurement that may be necessary for the use of the Standard Documents. These Standard Documentscomma which will be based on the provisions of the Polish Act on Public Procurementcomma will enable procuring entities to implement the law effectively and will prevent use of different standard forms as well as duplication of efforts. The Bidding Documents shall be prepared by national and internationalcomma individual or institutionalcomma experienced consultantscomma selected following the World Bank selection procedures. The consultants qualification criteria will include their knowledge and practice in use of Standard Documents of international institutions such as the World Bank or FIDIC so that the output of their services reflects the best practice of other procurement systemscomma and their knowledge of the Polish procurement related legislation to accommodate the international experience. As a result of preparation of the Standard Documents the Consultants shall be required to define and propose amendments of the Act on Public Procurement to enable the adoption of these Documents for public procurement. The consultants shall also be required to provide training to concerned entities on the use of these documents. Consultants shall also be employed to carry out workshops. Dissemination of the Standard Documents shall be conducted through the following means: posting on the PPO web sitecomma printing and distribution to associationscomma commercial and other concerned procuring entities. Benefits The introduction of Standard Documents will: - Allow procuring entities to draw from a wide national and international experience in procurementcomma - Expedite preparation of the procurement processcomma - Make more effective use of resources during bidding preparationcomma - Avert mistakes which may both expose procuring entities to additional costs and delay of the investment process as wellcomma - Invoke better discipline within the procuring entitiescomma - Result in less procurement cancellations due to formal and procedural reasonscomma - Contribute to development of procurement staff and improvement of procurement capacitycomma - Gradually improve bidders credibility and response and will result in better prices as they become used to them and spend less time and resources on bid preparation. Through the above Project implementation will result in: - better economy and efficiency of projects implementationcomma - improved transparency and fairness of the procurement process. Expected outcome The following outcome is expected under the grant funded project: - Pre-qualification standard forms (article 23 of the Act)comma - Standard Bidding Documents for: commacommagoodscomma commacommaworkscomma commacommacomputers and information systemscomma commacommasmaller contracts (less then 30comma 000 Euro)comma commacommaservicescomma commacommaServices following Performance Contracting Principles. - standard forms of contractscomma - Guidance materials for use of above mentioned documentscomma - Recommendations on amendment to Public Procurement Law. The performance measures for the proposed activity is the adoption of the Standard Documents and other deliverables (as described above) by PPO and number of firms and trainees trained for use of the Standard Documents. Sustainability: The Standard Documents shall be initially disseminated among stakeholders under the proposed IDF financed Project. Thereaftercomma PPO shall maintain a website from which all interested parties will be able to download these documents. PPO shall also provide follow up consultation with various stakeholders to assess experience and lessons learned during the first year (s) use of these documents and propose modifications to the Documents or the Act as deemed necessary in light of experience. Relationship of Grant Proposal with Country Economic and Sector Work (or Business Plan) The Country Procurement Assessment Report identified a need for Standard Bidding Documents to enhance economycomma efficiency and transparency of procurement process. Similar suggestions were included in the Report “Corruption in Poland” that became a basis for the prepared ESW anti-corruption Activity in Poland. Results of the IDF-financed Project will contribute to this Activity through enhancing transparency and fairness in procurement process. The Project is fully consistent with both the 1999 Country Assistance Strategy (CAS) update as well as with the draft new CAS preliminary document. Government Agency Responsible for Execution The Public Procurement Office (PPO) shall be responsible for implementation of the Project. PPO shall assign a Project Leader to lead the Project activities. PPO shall set up an Advisory Committee comprising experts on public procurement and representing different stakeholders. The Committee shall provide its opinion and comments on the outcome provided by the Consultants to the Project Leader. Government Contribution (Cash or In-Kind) The Government contribution shall be 50comma000 USDcomma of which 30comma000 USD in cash to cover PPOs costs for dissemination of resultscomma printing and distributioncomma arrangements for stakeholder meetingscomma dissemination and other workshopscomma additional consulting costs that may be needed to achieve the Project objectivecomma translation. In-kind contribution shall include provision of the office facilities for the consultantscomma necessary transportation and office services. Other Comments Introduction of Standard Documents will allow to transfer international experience and contribute to harmonization of procurement system with the European law and practice. It will also allow for a dialogue with the World Bank to develop procurement system consistent with international standards.
